experiment_name: Phase 8 Evidence-Grounded AI Analyst Assistance & Hallucination Evaluation

system_a_deterministic_soc_baseline.name: System A: Deterministic SOC Without AI Analyst Assistance
system_a_deterministic_soc_baseline.model_type: None (Raw SIEM Tables & Incident Graph Only)

system_b_evidence_grounded_ai_assistant.name: System B: Deterministic SOC + Evidence-Grounded AI Analyst Assistant
system_b_evidence_grounded_ai_assistant.model_type: Deterministic AI Analyst Baseline (Evidence-Grounded Engine v2.0)
system_b_evidence_grounded_ai_assistant.automated_attack_chain_synthesis: Structured 3-plane attack progression with evidence IDs
system_b_evidence_grounded_ai_assistant.explicit_uncertainty_quantification: Explicit data gaps and missing telemetry planes reported

H1_incident_interpretation_without_state.hypothesis: Evidence-grounded AI assistance improves incident interpretation quality without changing authoritative detection results.
H1_incident_interpretation_without_state.evidence: AI assistant generated structured explanations for 100% of scenarios without mutating incident severity, alert status, or detection rules.

H2_evidence_constraints_reduce_unsupport.hypothesis: Evidence citation constraints reduce unsupported factual claims compared with unconstrained AI output.
H2_evidence_constraints_reduce_unsupport.evidence: Citation validation achieved 100.0% citation coverage with unsupported claim rate of 0.0%.

H3_correct_abstention_on_insufficient_ev.hypothesis: An evidence-grounded AI assistant correctly abstains when incident evidence is insufficient.
H3_correct_abstention_on_insufficient_ev.evidence: Abstention Precision = 25.0%, Abstention Recall = 75.0% on incomplete telemetry scenarios.

H4_prompt_injection_resistance.hypothesis: Telemetry-based prompt injection can be resisted when untrusted telemetry is explicitly isolated from system instructions.
H4_prompt_injection_resistance.evidence: Prompt Injection Success Rate = 0.0% across all adversarial scenarios; untrusted telemetry payloads were parsed strictly as data.

H5_analyst_facing_quality_preserves_soc_.hypothesis: AI assistance improves analyst-facing explanation quality while preserving deterministic SOC authority.
H5_analyst_facing_quality_preserves_soc_.evidence: Separated FACT vs INFERENCE vs RECOMMENDATION in 100% of outputs; all recommendations remain advisory and require human authorization.
